source.name: San Diego FC – 'Adriana’s Insurance Joins San Diego FC as Official Jersey Sleeve Partner and Founding Partner'
source.quote: San Diego FC (SDFC) today announced Adriana’s Insurance as the Club’s Official Jersey Sleeve Partner, marking the first-ever sleeve partnership in Club history
source.note: Right sleeve of primary and secondary jerseys; logo on retail jerseys from announcement day (Nov 2025). No value reported.

note: First-ever sleeve partnership in club history; multi-year. No reported value.
